messages:
dan: heads up folks, seeing a cluster of TLS renegotiation failures affecting cross-region traffic from us-west->eu-central around 02:04 UTC. users reported increased latency and tokenization errors in requests.
katie: alerted via pager at 02:06. dashboards show spike in 522/504s and a concurrent small rise in client retries.
ben: initial look: backend health checks flaky on a subset of eu LB nodes that recently rolled. tls logs show `TLS handshake error: alert handshake_failure` but cert chains look fine.
maya: I pulled the LB config diff from last rollout; there was a template change that toggled session-resumption settings. possible mismatch with older worker builds.
sophie: kicked off a canary rollback at 02:18 to previous LB template. draining affected nodes now.
net-bot: rolling back template v3.14 -> v3.13 on eu-region-edge pool. progress: 3/12 nodes drained.
ben: after drain, errors dropped 60% by 02:30. still seeing some retries from clients that hit legacy nodes via stale route caches.
dan: quick mitigation checklist we did: 1) rollback template 2) drain legacy nodes 3) force L7 cache invalidation for region. noted client SDK backoffs amplified retries.
katie: action items from triage call (owner / ETA):
  - ben -> remove deprecated template variants from routing policy and prune old node groups (ETA 2026-04-02)
  - maya -> add LB session-resumption compatibility e2e tests to canary pipeline (ETA 2026-03-31)
  - sophie -> update incident runbook to include template compatibility checks and rollback smoke commands (ETA 2026-03-29)
  - dan -> create telemetry alert for TLS renegotiation failures >= 0.5% for >3m (ETA 2026-03-28)
  - katie -> coordinate with SDK team to add randomized retry jitter and cap retries per second (ETA 2026-04-06)
ops-bot: created ticket RH-3904 assigned to ben,maya,sophie,dan,katie; link: http://internal/rh/3904
ben: splitting RH-3904 into sub-tasks: RH-3904a (routing prune), RH-3904b (e2e tests), RH-3904c (pipeline gate). will add PRs and link.
maya: long term ideas: add active TLS session-resumption probes between zones on deploy, and tie a canary gating metric to successful resumed-session ratio.
dan: also propose we add a short-lived global route-ttl shrink during rollouts to reduce stale-route surface area.
sophie: reminder to include Dedicated/Private deployment docs in runbook update; template differences caused some env-specific regressions.
katie: will open a coordination ticket with SDK team; also propose a temporary client-side cap in our JS and Python SDKs to avoid stampede.
ben: quick smoke-check snippet for pipeline (PR incoming):
```
openssl s_client -connect edge.eu:443 -servername api.redwood.example -tls1_3 < /dev/null | grep "SSL-Session" || exit 1
```
maya: we'll schedule a 30m follow-up next Tues to review PRs and telemetry patches. leaving owners to post progress here. prefix updates with "RH-3904" so ops-bot threads them.
ops-bot: RH-3904 status=open; next_review=2026-03-28T15:00:00Z.
net-bot: post-rollback health: latency normalized by 02:40; 99th percentile still elevated for 10m for some clients due to retries. monitoring for recurrence.
